title: Bias Mitigation in Fine-tuning Pre-trained Models for Enhanced Fairness and Efficiency

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fairness metrics including Demographic Parity Distance and Equalized Odds on binary classification tasks across gender groups, specifically for predicting income (Adult Income dataset) and hair attributes (CelebA dataset).

Measuring Demographic Parity Distance and Equalized Odds on a gender classification task (LFW+a dataset) using the presence of 'HeavyMakeup' as the sensitive attribute, which acts as a proxy due to its strong correlation with females.
